verdict.rationale: Vast.ai docs explicitly describe self-serve, no-sales-cycle provisioning (CLI/API/search) and a dedicated guide for multi-node training via overlay networks and NCCL (vast-ai-docs-12/18), plus search filters for multi-GPU offers (vast-ai-gh-1, vast-ai-docs-20). However, since it's a marketplace of heterogeneous hosts, actual interconnect quality/bandwidth varies by host rather than being a guaranteed 'fast interconnect' SKU, and community reports note inconsistent bandwidth/performance versus listed specs (vast-ai-comm-4, vast-ai-comm-7). Missing for 10: documented guaranteed high-bandwidth/InfiniBand-class interconnect tier, benchmarked multi-node throughput numbers, and independent confirmation that provisioned clusters reliably hit advertised interconnect speeds.
